chunks: The heavens itself will be rent asunder (on that day). His promise is bound to be fulfilled.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the sky on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir highlights the absolute certainty of divine retribution, emphasizing that the cosmic splitting of the heavens is not merely a physical event but a manifestation of God's fulfilled promise. The phrase 'was his promise fulfilled' underscores the inevitability of the Resurrection, serving as a stern warning to the disbelievers of Mecca who doubted the accountability of their deeds.
